name: write_goal
description: Turn a rough natural-language intent into a structured goal draft without consulting a model. Inspects state/goals.json for an already-open goal first, asks up to 4 material questions (via ask_user, or records assumptions when headless), and returns BOTH a machine-readable record and a readable markdown rendering. Draft-only: never persists, never starts a run, never calls goal.
llm_description: Draft a goal from a rough intent: {intent:'...', max_questions?:1..4, parent?:bool}. Checks state/goals.json for an existing open goal covering the intent and reports it instead of duplicating; otherwise asks only the material (open) forks and returns {ok, duplicate, existing_goal_id, record:{objective,completion_criteria,verification,boundaries,execution_loop,stop_rules,assumptions,unresolved_questions}, markdown}. It neither persists the goal nor starts a run — persist by handing the record to the goal tool as a separate step.

intent.description: The rough natural-language goal intent. Required.

max_questions.description: Interview budget: how many material questions to ask (1-4).

parent.description: Route questions to the parent agent (sub-agent runs) instead of the human.
